lane_role: MANDATORY axis: realized-inflation PPP-deviation misalignment, outcome-blind proposal 1 of 2 (the P2-census 36m class, raw-band form)
title: 36m realized-inflation PPP-deviation misalignment: raw-band mean-reversion of the spot-vs-price-level gap on the funded pairs
mechanism: Who is slow/forced: (1) reserve managers and sovereign-wealth funds rebalance FX reserves against trade-weighted purchasing-power targets on quarterly-to-annual budget cycles — they are valuation-motivated, not momentum-motivated, and their mandates force trimming of currencies whose spot rate has drifted far beyond realized relative inflation; (2) corporate treasurers set fiscal-year hedge ratios off budget-rate purchasing power and scale hedges when the realized relative cost base (CPI index levels) says a funding/currency exposure is materially mispriced; (3) neither population stops out or chases — they are the slowest flow cohort in FX, acting on months-scale budget cycles, so spot absorbs extreme misalignment over weeks-to-months rather than instantly. Why the effect exists: the 36m spot return minus cumulative relative CPI measures how far spot has drifted from the realized price-level anchor these mandates literally reference; extreme drift attracts value-motivated rebalancing flow that pushes spot back toward the anchor (PPP-class reversion at the mandate horizon). The mechanism is MEAN-REVERSION IN THE DEVIATION, not trend-following: the traded signal is m = 36m nominal spot return MINUS the cumulative relative-CPI change, and when the two components offset — a strong nominal trend fully explained by the inflation differential — m ~= 0 and NO trade fires even though a large nominal trend exists; the construction itself, not an argument, separates the deviation from the trend (the V8 nominal-LEVEL shadow PF 1.2268 is a trend/level exposure; this anchor trades only what the trend fails to explain). Observable: per pair, m_p(t) = log(S_p(t)/S_p(t-36m)) - [cumulative 36m log CPI change of the non-US leg minus the US leg], both legs consumed as-of the decision instant from the vintaged channel at their pinned announcement instants; the state evolves daily through its spot leg and steps at print-pair instants through its CPI legs; decisions occur ONLY at print-pair decision instants. When it MUST fail: (i) if the identical geometry on the nominal 36m trend alone (misalignment removed — the mandatory control) reproduces the anchor's expectancy (same sign, >= 0.5x), the state is nominal-trend exposure in new words — exactly the V8 death (F1-a); (ii) if pooled |rho| of the anchor state vs the V8 d2 schedules or the nominal-trend field exceeds 0.20 at D2, it dies before scoring (ancestry veto — 'a PPP anchor whose state is dominated by the nominal trend dies'); (iii) if the +7d sham-calendar reproduces the anchor (same sign, >= 0.5x), the genuine print timing carries no information and the book is generic slow exposure (F1-b); (iv) if PPP reversion at the mandate horizon is slower than the 36m window (Rogoff half-life 3-5y), the fade expectancy is non-positive and the frozen gates fail (F1-c / rule order); (v) if trade counts are too thin to clear the 6 bps round-trip tier-2.0 cost, the break-even gate fails structurally.

universe.position_convention: pair-instrument convention, uniform in m: m_p > 0 means the instrument's base currency is REAL-overvalued -> SHORT the pair instrument; m_p < 0 -> LONG. transforms.as_of_single_snapshot: each decision consumes ONE as-of snapshot per leg: the vintaged observation whose available_time <= the decision instant (latest pinned print published by then); no splicing across snapshots or vintages; every transform (spot 36m return, y/y chain sum, band comparison) computed inside that one snapshot
transforms.rebase_safety: cumulative relative CPI over 36m = sum of y/y log steps (36 monthly steps for GB/CA/US legs, 12 quarterly steps for AU/NZ legs) within a single snapshot; y/y ratios telescope exactly to the 36m log change and are invariant to index rebasing within a vintage; cross-rebase pairs are guarded by the inherited V8 rebase/revision event map (GB 5 rebase-class events; CA 5 rebase-class + 216 revision events; AU rebase inside S0 captured at vintage 2018-10-09; NZ revised-class samples) — the vintaged channel carries vintage-consistent index bases by construction
transforms.variant_axis_declared: band form = RAW log units, NO z-standardization anywhere in this proposal (frozen bands: entry |m| >= 0.040, exit |m| <= 0.015); raw bands need no statistical warmup, which the short usable grid (spot coverage 2020-01-30+ forcing a 2023-02 start for the 36m class) cannot afford — the z-standardization axis is exercised by proposal-2 at the 12m horizon instead
transforms.lags_policy: each CPI leg is consumed at its own availability instant; the binding instant for a pair is the LATER of (non-US leg instant, US leg instant); I/Q availability-lag mutation must move the consumed decision exactly one period per field (a print arriving late shifts the decision exactly one period, never absorbs)

decision_clock.spec: per pair: the FIRST daily 16:00 America/New_York (DST-correct) clock STRICTLY AFTER the LATER leg availability instant of the binding CPI print pair (announcement instants from the pinned calendars GB aad19697 / CA_v3 0f1a9328 / AU 42a4e4a3 / NZ 62f82c23; US leg availability = vintaged realtime_start instant); FX 24/5 weekday convention; the book is event-driven on this per-pair decision grid — entries, hysteresis exits and forced exits are all evaluated ONLY at these instants (daily-or-slower satisfied: monthly pairs ~12 decision instants/yr, quarterly pairs ~4/yr); fills at that instant's 16:00-NY close

entry_exit_fills.entry: at a per-pair decision instant, when no position is open in that pair and |m_p| >= 0.040: SHORT the pair instrument if m_p > 0 (base currency real-overvalued), LONG if m_p < 0; fill = that instant's 16:00-NY close
entry_exit_fills.exit: hysteresis close at the first subsequent decision instant with |m_p| <= 0.015; otherwise forced close at the 2nd decision instant after entry (max_hold_decision_events = 2); no discretionary exits; positions never overlap within a pair; exits at the decision instant's 16:00-NY close
entry_exit_fills.fills: same-instant market fill at the daily 16:00-NY close; no intrabar logic; no slippage model beyond the cost ladder
entry_exit_fills.dual_book: price-only book and financing-adjusted book carried per frozen invariant 6 (sign non-inversion {0,1} vs 0.0)

anchor.spec: 36m misalignment raw-band fade on all 4 funded pairs: at each per-pair decision instant, |m| >= 0.040 triggers SHORT instrument (m > 0) or LONG instrument (m < 0); hysteresis exit |m| <= 0.015; forced exit at the 2nd decision instant after entry; equal risk per pair; dual books
anchor.mechanism_bearing_component: the DEVIATION m = 36m spot return MINUS cumulative relative CPI — the part of the nominal trend the realized price levels do NOT explain

neighbour.type: MANDATORY +7d sham-calendar placebo, occupying the neighbour slot (print instants condition the book; 3-arm budget; V8 precedent FXFV8-A4-P2)
neighbour.spec: IDENTICAL rule in every field — same raw bands (0.040/0.015), same 2-event forced hold, same direction convention, same universe, same dual books — except the per-pair decision calendar is shifted +7 calendar days: entries/exits evaluated at instants+7d, state re-computed as-of those shifted instants under identical availability semantics, fills at the shifted instants' 16:00-NY closes

control.type: causal control — MANDATORY nominal-exposure form (plan 2(b), p3 mandatories_per_family)
control.spec: identical rule geometry with the misalignment removed: input n_p(t) = log(S_p(t)/S_p(t-36m)) alone (the p2 census nominal_36m_trend_control field), same entry band |n| >= 0.040 / exit |n| <= 0.015, same fade direction convention (n > 0 -> SHORT instrument), same per-pair event grid, same 2-event forced hold, same universe and dual books
control.identifiability: differs from the anchor ONLY in the mechanism-bearing input (the relative-CPI leg is deleted); on decision instants where the CPI differential offsets the nominal trend the anchor stands aside while the control trades — that overlap asymmetry is exactly the refutation surface; the control neither subsumes nor is subsumed by the anchor
control.refutes: the convenient explanation 'this is just nominal price-trend / V8 nominal-LEVEL shadow exposure relabelled' — D2 measures this control DIRECTLY against the V8 shadow (PF 1.2268) and the nominal-trend field

falsification_rule.primary_numeric: F1-a NOMINAL SHADOW: if the control arm's financing-adjusted expectancy per trade at tier 2.0 has the SAME SIGN as the anchor's AND |exp_control| >= 0.5 x |exp_anchor|, the family DIES as nominal-price-trend exposure in new words (V8 R1-class; falsification-by-control cluster instance)
secondary_numeric: F1-b SHAM REPRODUCTION: if the +7d sham neighbour's fin-adj expectancy at tier 2.0 has the anchor's sign AND >= 0.5 x the anchor's, the genuine print timing carries no incremental information -> family DIES

F1-c DIRECTION REFUTATION: if anchor expectancy at tier 2.0 < 0 while the control expectancy > 0, the mean-reversion direction is refuted (nominal momentum dominates value reversion at this horizon) -> family DIES; a sign flip is FORBIDDEN as rescue (sign-flip of a rejected cell)

F1-d ANCESTRY VETO (measured at D2 pre-selection, before any PnL): pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the anchor's conditioning state and ANY forbidden-ancestry exposure — including the V8 d2 schedules AND the nominal-trend field — kills the anchor before scoring
F1-e INHERITED BASELINES: any arm failing the frozen rule_order 1..10 (p3_invariants_freeze_v9.json) fails; the family is promotable only if the anchor passes all gates AND none of F1-a..F1-d fires
falsification_rule.nonvacuity: if anchor trades < 24 S0-wide, or any fold has 0 anchor trades, the cell is VOID as vacuous (BLOCKED_SELECTION-class), not evidence about the mechanism; unused slot never reassigned

expected_failure_interpretation.F1-a_fire: the realized-inflation deviation adds nothing beyond the nominal trend — purchasing-power misalignment is not a separable tradable component of G10 spot at the 36m horizon; the misalignment class closes exactly as V8's expectation class closed (by its own mandatory control)
expected_failure_interpretation.F1-b_fire: the state is so slow that a 7-day calendar shift is informationally empty -> the book is generic slow valuation exposure, not print-anchored mechanism; recorded as negative information, not pursued
expected_failure_interpretation.F1-c_fire: nominal momentum dominates value-driven reversion at the mandate horizon (Rogoff-consistent: half-life longer than the window); the frozen fade direction is wrong and a sign flip is FORBIDDEN as rescue
expected_failure_interpretation.gates_fail_no_falsifier: genuine mechanism-specific reversion exists but not at tradeable margins — the most likely surface is the break-even gate (6 bps round trip vs a thin trade count) or stress tier 2.0; the thin-margin class per P-2, recorded with margins_to_fail scaffolding
